title: Google Ads for Local Service Based Businesses

facts.fact: The page states that in some industries cost-per-click (CPC) rates are soaring above $50.
facts.quote: With some industries seeing cost-per-click (CPC) rates soaring above $50

facts.fact: The page recommends launching remarketing only after a site has reached 1,000 visitors.
facts.quote: Launch remarketing only after hitting 1,000 visitors

facts.fact: The page recommends setting location targeting to "Presence" only so ads show to people physically located in the service area.
The page's vendor (Define Digital Academy) gives an example in which an IT support company's cost per lead dropped from $107 to $59 after adding negative keywords and rewriting ads.
facts.quote: their cost per lead dropped from $107 to $59

facts.fact: In the vendor's IT support example, the company's cost per lead was over $100 before changes, largely due to calls from residential customers.
facts.quote: An IT support company saw costs per lead of over $100

facts.fact: The page recommends reviewing the search terms report weekly to refine targeting and reduce irrelevant clicks.
facts.quote: Review your search terms report weekly to refine targeting and reduce irrelevant clicks

facts.fact: The page recommends creating both account-level and campaign-level negative keyword lists.
facts.quote: Create both account-level and campaign-level negative keyword lists

facts.fact: The page advises starting with Search campaigns rather than Performance Max (PMAX) when launching or optimizing Google Ads.
facts.quote: always begin with Search campaigns, not Performance Max (PMAX)
